_doc: Marksman line (spec #360, ticket MS2 #362): the skill definitions of the Marksman (322), empty until the skill tickets land. Each ticket appends its own region (a repeated key across files is a load error): MS5 #365 iron_arrow (moved here from skills/bowman.json), strafe_crossbow, dragons_breath_crossbow; MS6 #366 blizzard_crossbow, arrow_eruption; MS7 #367 piercing_arrow; MS8 #368 snipe; MS9 #369 golden_eagle, frostprey. arrow_blow is Bowmaster's shared definition in skills/bowmaster.json and is not redefined here.

iron_arrow.name: Iron Arrow: Crossbow
iron_arrow.desc: Fires a piercing arrow that loses damage with each monster struck.
iron_arrow._tier: Tier A: canonical crossbow weapon 46, mobCount 6 (pierce 5), damage 122..180%, ball/effect/hit art and the Use sound, all 30 levels. Tier C (MS5 #365, GAME_DESIGN 7.46.9): ported from skills/bowman.json (the weapon gate and the explicit 30 ranks are gone: the default eight ranks, rank 8 is WZ level 30), nearest target, 1s cooldown, 300px reach, 600px/s flight, 8px radius, 0.6s held-weapon shooting hold; one base arrow; linear 0.1 fall-off per contact, floor 0.1 (sixth mob 50%); rarity bonuses named after the Crossbowman passives. Untuned.

strafe_crossbow.name: Strafe
strafe_crossbow.desc: Fires a volley of crossbow bolts at one monster.
strafe_crossbow._tier: Tier A: WZ damage 71..100% per arrow, bulletCount 4, weapon 46 (crossbow), hit/0 art (3 frames) and the Use sound (a UOL into the 3111006 node; the art and numbers are node for node the Bowmaster's). Tier C (MS5 #365, GAME_DESIGN 7.46.9): a crossbow copy of `strafe` with its own id, book and job so the Skill window lists it on the Sniper tab (the Bowmaster's shared key would sit on no tab of a Marksman); the eight survivor ranks, `cast.focus`, 2.5s cooldown, 350px range, 700px/s, 6px radius, no pierce, 0.6s held weapon stance, rarity bonuses. Untuned.

dragons_breath_crossbow.name: Dragon's Breath
dragons_breath_crossbow.desc: Looses a dragon-fire arrow that pierces a line of monsters and knocks each one back.
dragons_breath_crossbow._tier: Tier A: WZ damage 42..100%, mobCount 4..6, range 440 (read from the level), prop 100, weapon 46 (crossbow), ball/hit/effect art and the Use/Hit sounds (UOLs into the 3121001 node; the art and numbers are node for node the Bowmaster's). Tier C (MS5 #365, GAME_DESIGN 7.46.9): a crossbow copy of `dragons_breath` with its own id, book and job (Marksman tab); the eight survivor ranks, nearest auto-cast with its own ball (no ammo sprite), 3.5s cooldown, 700px/s, 16px radius, `pierce_field` mobCount (pierces mobCount - 1), a 180px knock-back that always rolls (prop 100; bosses are damaged and not moved), 0.6s held weapon stance, rarity bonuses. Untuned.

blizzard_crossbow.name: Blizzard
blizzard_crossbow.desc: Calls down a blizzard of ice arrows around you. The ice lands a moment after the cast and can freeze what it hits.

text.desc: Calls down a blizzard of ice arrows around you. The ice lands a moment after the cast and can freeze what it hits.
text.h: Damage {damage}%, {x}% chance to freeze for {time} sec.

blizzard_crossbow._tier: Tier A: weapon46 (crossbow), elemAttr i, damage 100..140% (levels 4/15/30 at ranks 1/4/8 read 106/128/140), the symmetric box (+-130 until level 15, +-150 from 16, by +-100), mobCount6, effect/hit/special art and Use/Hit sounds. Tier C (#366, GAME_DESIGN 7.46.6): the eight survivor ranks, a box cast anchored where the caster stood that strikes 0.6s later (start 150ms + 4 x interval 90ms rounded up; the delayed-strike seam of Meteor Shower and Arrow Rain), min_targets 1, 4s cooldown, 0.6s held weapon stance; the freeze reads the WZ x (21..50) as the chance in percent and time (1..3) as the seconds, because the node has no prop, rolled on stream 1 per struck monster, bosses and ice-immune kinds reject it; the special node (x 105, y 130, fall 400, start 150, interval 90, count 5) read as five ice arrows falling 400px over 0.25s, one every 90ms across the box (art only); rarity bonuses. Untuned.

arrow_eruption.name: Arrow Eruption
arrow_eruption.desc: Arrows erupt around you over a wide area. The damage lands a moment after the cast.

text.desc: Arrows erupt around you over a wide area. The damage lands a moment after the cast.

arrow_eruption._tier: Tier A: weapon46 (crossbow), damage 60..160% (levels 4/15/30 at ranks 1/4/8 read 75/122/160), the symmetric box (+-170 until level 10, +-190 until 20, +-210 from 21, by +-100), mobCount6, effect/hit/special art and the Use sound (the node has no Hit sound and no prepare). Tier C (#366, GAME_DESIGN 7.46.6): the eight survivor ranks, a box cast anchored where the caster stood that strikes 0.5s later (the numbers and the delay of Arrow Rain), min_targets 1, 5s cooldown, 0.6s held weapon stance, the special node (x 0, y -150, fall 150, count 3) read as three arrows erupting around the caster, one every 90ms across the box and landing at the impact (art only); rarity bonuses. Untuned.

snipe.name: Snipe
snipe.desc: Takes a big bite out of the strongest monster in reach. A boss only loses a sliver.
snipe._tier: Tier A: the book-322 skill id, the Use and Hit sounds, the effect / ball / hit art, no weapon field (the node has no damage, range or mobCount). Tier C (#368, GAME_DESIGN 7.46.10): fixed-share damage (7.47, the WZ cooltime 250..4 s is a session value and is not used), the eight-rank share table 20..45% of max HP, the 20x cap and the boss 0.1 share scale and 6x cap, the strongest-non-boss-first target rule, 450 px reach, 1200 px/s cosmetic bolt, 10 s cooldown, 0.6 s held weapon stance (the crossbow's shoot2, ROSTER_PLAN D11), rarity bonuses. Untuned.

golden_eagle._rarity: Tier C: first-pass #360 bonuses (Crossbow Mastery damage, Eagle Eyes area, Second Eagle +1 follower); repeat scale 0.8. See GAME_DESIGN 7.46.9.
golden_eagle.name: Golden Eagle
golden_eagle.desc: Calls an eagle that follows you and strikes a monster, which it may stun.
golden_eagle._provenance: Tier A: pad 32..100, prop 59..99%, time 112..180 s, one monster in a +-200 x +-150 box, attackAfter 100 ms, summon/hit art and the Use/Summon sounds. Tier C: 30 s recast, fly follow settings, hover 20, 1.6 s attack cycle, 1.5 s stun, settle (the Silver Hawk's values); GAME_DESIGN 7.46.9.

frostprey._rarity: Tier C: first-pass #360 bonuses (Marksman Boost damage, Cold Wings a fifth target, Second Frostprey +1 follower); repeat scale 0.8. See GAME_DESIGN 7.46.9.
frostprey.name: Frostprey
frostprey.desc: Calls a frostprey that follows you and strikes up to four monsters at a time with ice.
frostprey._provenance: Tier A: elemAttr i, pad 270..500 at the mapped levels, time 122..200 s, up to 4 monsters in a +-100 x +-60 box, attackAfter 1440 ms, hit art and the Use/Summon sounds. Tier C: 40 s recast, fly follow settings, hover 20, 3.0 s attack cycle, settle (the Phoenix's values). Balance flag: pad is 3-6 times an arrow's W.Att; GAME_DESIGN 7.46.9.
